pgvector — Open-source vector similarity search for Postgres

pgvector adds vector similarity search directly to PostgreSQL, supporting L2, inner product, and cosine distance. Ideal for RAG pipelines that want to avoid a separate vector database by storing embeddings alongside structured data.
